# ShipMonk

ShipMonk is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. ShipMonk is a leading 3PL fulfillment company for D2C ecommerce brands. They offer fast fulfillment, accuracy, and technology built to scale with their customers. ShipMonk employs 1,307 people (+11.7% YoY, +137 people) and has an annual revenue of $309.9M, founded in 2014. Headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States, with presence in Mexico, Czechia, and United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including United States, Czechia, Mexico, Canada, and Philippines).

## About

Since 2014, ShipMonk has operated with a singular guiding principle: help ecommerce brands scale through technology-driven fulfillment solutions that enable entrepreneurs to devote more time to the things that matter most in their businesses. Put simply, here at ShipMonk we help ecommerce brands STRESS LESS and GROW MORE.

Headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, ShipMonk proudly employs 2,000+ team members across a network of 11 state-of-the-art facilities located throughout the US, Canada, and Europe. We are America’s fastest-growing third-party logistics provider (3PL) for DTC, B2B, and retail fulfillment, specializing in the facilitation of sustained growth for ecommerce brands of all sizes across all verticals. Our enterprise-level fulfillment services stand out amongst other 3PLs thanks to our seamless integrations, superior shipping rates and services, and powerful order, inventory, and warehouse management technology.

Each year, ShipMonk is recognized by ecommerce industry leaders and publications for our commitment to innovation. For example: The Inc. 5000 List of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies for eight consecutive years, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500™️, and Entrepreneur Magazine’s 360 List of Best Entrepreneurial Companies in America. Most recently ShipMonk was recognized as a Business Intelligence Group “Company of the Year” for the third year in a row, and ShipMonk founder Jan Bednar was named a National Winner in Ernst & Young’s Entrepreneur of the Year®️ Awards.

properties.name: Ruby Has Fulfillment (A ShipMonk Company)
properties.description:
Since 2014, ShipMonk has operated with a singular guiding principle: help ecommerce brands scale through technology-driven fulfillment solutions that enable entrepreneurs to devote more time to the things that matter most in their businesses. Put simply, here at ShipMonk we help ecommerce brands STRESS LESS and GROW MORE.

Headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, ShipMonk proudly employs 2,000+ team members across 12 state-of-the-art facilities located throughout the US, Canada, Mexico, and Europe. We are America’s fastest-growing third-party logistics provider (3PL) for DTC, B2B, and retail fulfillment, specializing in the facilitation of sustained growth for ecommerce brands of all sizes across all verticals. Our enterprise-level fulfillment services stand out amongst other 3PLs thanks to our seamless integrations, superior shipping rates and services, and powerful order, inventory, and warehouse management technology.

Each year, ShipMonk is recognized by ecommerce industry leaders and publications for our commitment to innovation. For example: The Inc. 5000 List of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies for five consecutive years, Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500™️, and Entrepreneur Magazine’s 360 List of Best Entrepreneurial Companies in America. Most recently ShipMonk was recognized as a Business Intelligence Group “Company of the Year” for the third year in a row, and ShipMonk founder Jan Bednar was named a National Winner in Ernst & Young’s Entrepreneur of the Year®️ Awards.
